n = int(input())
v = list(map(int, input().split()))
v.sort()
t = int(input())
result = -1
for i in range(n):
    # Find the upper bound for v[i] + t
    # Using binary search to find the index where v[i] + t would be inserted
    left, right = i, n
    while left < right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        if v[mid] <= v[i] + t:
            left = mid + 1
        else:
            right = mid
    idx = left
    result = max(result, idx - i)
print(result)
